description: Establish and confirm the green baseline on branch stack at the current HEAD before any change. The venv and node_modules already exist; this verifies the documented exact-tree gates reproduce the known-good counts so later features can be judged against a trustworthy starting line.
steps: Confirm the repo venv works: .venv/bin/python --version must report 3.12.x (NEVER use system python3 = 3.9; conftest.py raises UsageError on <3.12).

If dependencies are missing, install dev deps: .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt (now resolves cleanly: multidict==6.9.1 with aiohttp==3.14.3). For frontend, npm ci (EBADENGINE node>=24 warning on node v22 is non-fatal).
Run the Python suite: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q and record the exact counts (expected 5717 passed, 1 skipped).
Run npx tsc --noEmit and record exit code (expected 0).
Run npx vitest run and record counts (expected 650 passed, 45 files).
Attempt npm run build; if it fails on a transient upstream 429 during /post/[slug] blog export, re-run once to confirm exit 0 — do NOT modify build code to work around network flakiness.
Record all observed counts in this feature's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: pytest reports 5717 passed, 1 skipped (or more passed if new tests already present on branch) with 0 failures
npx vitest run reports 650 passed with 0 failures
npm run build exits 0 (after at most one re-run for the known transient blog 429)
